name: DiffNeRF
aliases: Regularization of NeRFs using differential geometry
definition: A generic framework for regularizing NeRFs using differential geometry to improve robustness with sparse or inconsistent data, by modifying the NeRF to represent continuous and infinitely differentiable functions.
summary: DiffNeRF is a NeRF regularization framework using automatic differentiation to compute depth gradients, improving robustness with sparse data without specialized dataloaders.
